scope: Frontend shared UI states and dialogs: Empty, QueryState, ErrorNotice, PartialDataNotice, CapabilityUnavailable, EditDialog, ConfirmDialog. Change only semantic spacing ownership and rendered geometry; preserve state semantics and mutation invariants.

spacingOwners.empty state content: Empty; semantic gap16, inline inset16, responsive block inset32 mobile/48 desktop from the existing semantic role
spacingOwners.loading state content: QueryState; semantic gap16, minHeight remains geometry
spacingOwners.notice after-content: one semantic notice owner; block-end16 for error/partial/stale/update notices
spacingOwners.notice internal guidance: ErrorNotice; semantic block-start8 for guidance/unknown command details
spacingOwners.dialog viewport: EditDialog; responsive outer margin16 mobile/32 desktop
spacingOwners.dialog content: DialogContent; responsive all-side inset16 mobile/24 desktop
spacingOwners.dialog actions: DialogActions; inset16, explicit gap8, no duplicate library margin

uiDesignContract.stateAndInteraction: Keep role=status/alert and live announcements; preserve no-retry semantics for 403/404; retry for transient and stale-data errors; focus matching invalid field on 422; preserve unknown-result warning, guidance, copyable command id, dirty draft baseline/commit, close/Escape/busy guard, discard confirmation and focus return; preserve ConfirmDialog reason validation and async close only after successful confirm.
uiDesignContract.verification: Before code capture existing dialog geometry at 1280x900 and 390x844, record screenshot/DOM metrics and observe the R30 Empty state when present. After code run 9 layout fixtures, shared components Vitest, full verify, and Chromium compare opened create/edit/confirm dialogs at the same viewports. Assert spacing roles, viewport bounds, accessible name/focus/error state, no document overflow or page errors; strict global count may only remove W08-owned findings. Empty state block inset follows the pre-existing bridge role: 32px mobile and 48px desktop.
uiDesignContract.preservation: Do not alter dirty-guard, mutation request, permission, query retry, role/live-region, focus management or generated/API contracts. Keep DialogContent and action ownership explicit; no double inset or generic style prop.
